newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish dental patient swallows screwdriver.
newsitem.headline: Swedish dental patient swallows screwdriver.

text.p: A Swede with toothache had to be taken to hospital for X-rays after a dentist dropped a small screwdriver into his mouth and he swallowed it.
The dentist, who has 20 years experience, was fastening the 63-year-old patient's bridge when he dropped a three cm (one inch) long screwdriver and it disappeared.
The patient was taken to hospital where X-rays showed the tool in his gullet. Later check-ups found it in his stomach.
The screwdriver did no harm and came out "the natural way", Swedish news agency TT said on Tuesday.
The dentist now always ties the screwdriver to his thumb when doing similar dental bridge jobs, it said.
